title: UAE Crescent Enterprises’ CE-Ventures invests in London startup Oyster Therapeutics
summary: Funding to help advance targeted protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases
contentHtml:

Funding to help advance targeted protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

UAE-based Crescent Enterprises’ CE-Ventures has invested in London-based biotech firm Oyster Therapeutics, formerly Kesmalea Therapeutics.
